summary: The internal orchestration dashboard loads and hydrates with live data, but the review cannot sign off the Stripe trial-to-paid conversion flow. The current "E2E" coverage is mock-only, the PRD contract has drifted from the shipped checkout/webhook implementation and schema, and the internal dashboard still has a live marketing attribution data failure.

walkthrough.actualBehavior: HTTP 200. The page rendered in a headless browser, hydrated mission/KPI/system sections, and showed live LeadFlow data. One widget failed at runtime: marketing attribution displayed "Attribution data not available" after a 404 on /rest/v1/real_estate_agents?select=utm_source,utm_medium,utm_campaign,id.

findings.summary: Stripe trial-to-paid flow is not actually validated end-to-end.
findings.details: tests/integration/stripe-checkout-e2e.test.js uses MockStripe and MockDatabase only. It does not import live route handlers, hit the real webhook route, or verify PostgreSQL state.

findings.summary: PRD acceptance criteria no longer match the live checkout implementation and schema.
findings.details: The customer UI is wired to /api/stripe/upgrade-checkout, not /api/billing/create-checkout-session. The real_estate_agents table has no stripe_subscription_id or plan_activated_at columns, and the Stripe webhook route does not update those fields on the agent record.

findings.summary: Internal dashboard marketing attribution card is broken.
findings.details: The dashboard issues a GET to /rest/v1/real_estate_agents?select=utm_source,utm_medium,utm_campaign,id which returns 404. The UI degrades to "Attribution data not available," removing signup-source visibility.

decisionsNeeded.summary: Choose the source-of-truth contract for Stripe conversion verification.

options.label: Align PRD/tests to shipped flow
options.description: Treat /api/stripe/upgrade-checkout plus subscriptions table state as the supported contract and rewrite verification around the real customer path.

options.label: Change product to match PRD
options.description: Keep the current PRD contract and retrofit the product to /api/billing/create-checkout-session plus agent-level subscription fields.

actionItems.title: Run a real Stripe test-mode conversion on the customer dashboard
actionItems.description: The checklist only exposed the internal dashboard. Revenue readiness still needs a real /signup/trial -> dashboard -> upgrade-checkout -> webhook -> paid-state walkthrough with Stripe test credentials and a disposable agent account.

actionItems.title: Choose the Stripe conversion contract source of truth
actionItems.description: PM, dev, and QC are currently validating different contracts. This blocks a clean sign-off on the trial-to-paid path.

options.label: Align PRD/tests to shipped flow
options.description: Use /api/stripe/upgrade-checkout and subscriptions table state as the contract.

options.label: Change product to match PRD
options.description: Retrofit the product to the current PRD endpoint and agent-level fields.

actionItems.title: Fix internal dashboard marketing attribution query
actionItems.description: The attribution card is currently non-functional because the underlying REST query returns 404.

architecturalDecisions.decision: Recommend using the shipped upgrade-checkout route and subscriptions table as the Stripe source of truth.
architecturalDecisions.reason: This is the shortest path to trustworthy conversion verification without adding duplicated subscription state to real_estate_agents.
architecturalDecisions.alternatives: Retrofit the product to the older PRD contract and duplicate more billing fields on the agent record.
